This '''school''' was located in [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

==History==
[[File:Mandalorian_pupils.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mandalorian pupils]]
The school was situated at the top of a skyscraper in the city on the planet Mandalore. It contained its own cantina and an elaborate chemical laboratory. The same building had a hangar for supply vessels to drop off supplies to the school. It received sufficient funding from the government.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the school was one of many on Mandalore which were affected by the epidemic caused by [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]]-spiked [[Ardees Beverage Company/Legends|Ardees Beverage]] [[Tea/Legends|tea]]. Children from the school were sent to a nearby [[Sundari Mandalorian hospital/Legends|hospital]] with great stomach pains.

The school's [[Unidentified Mandalorian school superintendent|superintendent]] was part of an illegal distribution deal which delivered the toxic beverage to the school, although he had no knowledge of the poisonous ingredient. The scheme was uncovered by a task force headed by [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and the superintendent was caught trying to flee from the premises.
